STEVEN: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I'm amazed you knew where to find me.\pDo you, uh…maybe think of me as
just a rock maniac?\pNo, that can't be right.\pWe battled alongside each other at
the SOOTOPOLIS SPACE CENTER.\pYou should have a very good idea
about how good I am.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you're going to mount
a serious challenge, expect the worst!
You…\nI had no idea you'd become so strong…

STEVEN: Come to think of it, ever since
our paths first crossed in GRANITE\lCAVE in DEWFORD, I had this feeling.\pI thought that you would eventually
become the CHAMPION.\pMy predictions usually come true.\pAnd where will you go from here?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pFufufu, even I couldn't tell you that.
